assets.prompt: Photorealistic agricultural field-training image of a botanically correct cassava plant with unambiguous cassava anthracnose disease: elongated dark-brown sunken cankers on young stems and petioles, small necrotic lesions, mild shoot dieback and distorted young leaves; natural overcast smartphone documentary photography; exclude other diseases, pests, text and watermarks.

Photorealistic cassava leaf with 7 narrow palmate lobes and numerous discrete small pale white or cream lesions with thin dark brown-to-purple margins; natural diffuse field smartphone photography; exclude other diseases, pests, text and watermarks.

Photorealistic whole cassava plant showing superelongation disease: abnormally long thin internodes, tall spindly weak architecture, curved stems, distorted small young leaves and shallow tan-to-brown stem and petiole cankers; field smartphone documentary photography; exclude other diseases, pests, text and watermarks.

Photorealistic object-detection seed showing multiple clearly separable small oval off-white waxy cassava mealybugs on young cassava shoot tips, stem nodes and leaf axils with modest wax and mild bunchy growth; natural field smartphone photograph; exclude whiteflies, mites, other disease, boxes, text and watermarks.

Photorealistic whole-plant cassava water-stress research image showing drooping petioles, limp folded palmate leaves, modest lower-leaf yellowing, slight marginal drying and cracked dry soil in harsh natural sunlight; exclude disease, insects, labels and watermarks; must later be paired with real soil-moisture and weather readings.

Photorealistic cassava plant with suspected potassium deficiency: turgid older lower leaves showing marginal chlorosis, narrow brown edge scorch and some interveinal yellowing while younger leaves remain greener; moist-normal soil; exclude disease, pests, drought, labels and watermarks; must later be paired with soil or tissue laboratory measurements.
